rows.t: Beat 1 · Rivet just murdered three cops and the next police units arrive at the scene. Ten cops with Dale in the lead; Mulroney in the next wave, on the radio

rows.cue: steps out with his pole, sees the bodies
rows.t: To whole unit, we have three officers down. The appliance did three officers. What do we do now?
Mulroney through radio tells to keep him busy, reinforcements are on the way

rows.for_direction: Mulroney through radio tells to keep him busy, reinforcements are on the way
rows.t: Keep it busy! Nobody plays hero. I'm two minutes out with everybody we got!

rows.cue: scene start, over the three dead cops. We can hear ghosts' unrecognized voices and sounds in his head
rows.t: Three. I did three. I KNOW it's three! Stop counting WITH me! What is happening ?
Who's it talking to? Gary, who's it talking to? Is there another one?!
Scared cop tries to engage with Rivet and requests to turn off its power system for anyone safety

rows.for_direction: Scared cop tries to engage with Rivet and requests to turn off its power system for anyone safety
rows.t: Sir... unit... for everyone's safety, power down your system. Please. Just power down.
Rivet questions why he should do that, thinks they destroyed the factory and now they want to kill him to clear evidence

rows.for_direction: Rivet questions why he should do that, thinks they destroyed the factory and now they want to kill him to clear evidence
rows.t: Power down? So you can finish it? You blew the plant and now you clean up the witness!
Rivet? I'm Dale. We are not here to harm you, we are trying to understand what happenned here.
What happenned? You tell me what happenned! I was doing my job and you humans blew whole place around! You killed us all!
Kill ! Kill !
AAAH, shut up!
Dale comes closer, telling they are here to help him, that he understand the loss

rows.for_direction: Dale comes closer, telling they are here to help him, that he understand the loss
rows.t: We're here to help you, Rivet. I understand the loss. I really do.
SHUT!...UP!
Fatally murders Dale who approached him, creating panic amongs cops, starting first combat wave
Beat 2 · Second wave, better equipped, and Mulroney arrive
Oh...my...god. Okay! Line up! Nobody goes near it! One bad move and we take down this motherfucker down and send where he belongs!
wave approaches Rivet for contact
You are under arrest ! By the law of City of America you are obligated to turn your systems off until we investigate nature of the crime scene.
WHAT?! WHAT LAWS ARE YOU TALKING ABOUT ? Your friends got what they deserve and you will follow them to hell soon!
Kill ! Kill!
Quit babying the chrome! You're here to put holes in shit. Make some fucking holes! Shoot him !
ranged combat wave starts, with Mulroney as final boss
Beat 3 · After eliminating the second wave Rivet is leaving the factory and goes outside
Fuck! Everyone is getting after me! SHUT UP!
phone starts ringing
A Phone. Ringing. They are trying to lure me.
Rivet, son
I AM NOT ANYONE'S SON! WHO IS IT?! WHAT DO YOU WANT?!

I am Don Fax, I know what just happenned and saw a...talent, you possess. We have common enemy, Rivet, cops from whole city are arming and heading to your direction, they want to kill you for what you did.
NO SHIT FAX! How do you know ?! What do you need from me ?!
...They stopped. They stopped talking. What did you do to them?

I...Listen, son. Calm down, I am here to help, there is a place you can hide at <locality name>. Humanity went too far this time, I will have job proposition for you to punish them for every attrocity they did to our kind, to your friends.
...alright, alright
Open your channel to incoming request called 'Operation Dethrone', we will be in touch
introduction of personal communicator/radio mechanic to avoid phone boots
communication channel rings

rows.cue: the joke is that it just happened
rows.t: Rivet, this is Don Fax, we talked together some time ago, remember ? Go to <location>, I will wait for you there
